'''Keloythian oak''' was a type of [[Wood/Legends|wood]] used to craft a large central table in a meeting hall of [[Sankar Palace]], a building in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jorra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. The meeting hall was the site of failed [[Battle of Jorra|cease-fire negotiations]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and in their violent aftermath, the table became slashed and burned.

==Description==
Keloythian oak was a type of [[Wood/Legends|wood]].<ref name="Chronicles" />

==History==
By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was used to craft a large table that was set in the center of a meeting hall of [[Sankar Palace]], a building in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jorra]] on the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] that was affiliated with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the war.<ref name="Chronicles" />

[[File:SuljoWardesFall-CotG.png|thumb|right|300px|Jedi Knight Suljo Warde carried out a slaughter of diplomats in the meeting hall housing a Keloythian oak table.]]
At one point during that conflict, the meeting hall housed [[Battle of Jorra|cease-fire talks]] between [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] Confederacy [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. However, just after the beginning of the negotiations, the Republic [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Suljo Warde]], who had become corrupted by his use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] [[Force power/Legends|ability]] of [[Precognition/Legends|precognition]] and had become convinced the talks were a mere ruse, decided to preemptively attack and [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Confederacy diplomats. Igniting his [[Suljo Warde's lightsaber|lightsaber]], he leaped across the table and slew the Neimoidians, after which Warde's fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jiv Durael]] and [[Kaddo Moll]] engaged him in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] throughout Sankar Palace in an attempt to arrest him. Shortly after that confrontation, Sankar Palace became the focus point of renewed fighting between the Confederacy and the Republic when the former retaliated for the slaughter of its diplomats.<ref name="Chronicles" />

{{RPG|''[[Chronicles of the Gatekeeper]]''}}
Two [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] later, a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals retracing Warde's steps during the Clone Wars visited the battle-damaged Sankar Palace, where they came across the slashed and burned Keloythian [[Oak tree|oak]] table in the meeting room that was strewn with combat debris.<ref name="Chronicles" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Keloythian oak appeared in ''[[Chronicles of the Gatekeeper]]'', a [[2015]] adventure published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying game]] system.<ref name="Chronicles" />
